Title: Azure Stream Analytics now supports error codes in activity and resource logs

Body.Content:
Azure Stream Analytics now supports the use of activity logs and resource logs for troubleshooting errors related to configuration, data, and both upstream and downstream services.

Learn more about Stream Analytics error codes.
